```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fig = d3.json(root + "assets/cost-accuracy.json")
viewof shown = Inputs.checkbox(Object.keys(names), {label: "Methods", value: ["A", "B", "C", "D"], format: k => names[k]})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
rows = fig.data.checkpoints.filter(d => shown.includes(d.method))
ends = Array.from(d3.group(rows, d => d.method).values(), g => g[g.length - 1])
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 860), height: 380, marginRight: 80, marginBottom: 46, style: {fontSize: "13px"},
  x: {label: "GPU-hours on one RTX 3060 →", domain: [0, 16], labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 38},
  y: {label: "↑ exact match on validation (%)", domain: [40, 90], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY(fig.data.baselines.filter(b => b.split === "validation"), {y: d => 100 * d.exact, stroke: "#898781", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text(fig.data.baselines.filter(b => b.split === "validation"), {x: 0, y: d => 100 * d.exact, text: d => d.model === "raw 2B" ? "2B teacher" : "untrained 0.8B", dy: -7, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#898781"}),
    Plot.line(rows.filter(d => !d.labels), {x: "gpu_hours", y: d => 100 * d.exact, z: "method", stroke: d => colors[d.method], strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.line(rows.filter(d => d.labels), {x: "gpu_hours", y: d => 100 * d.exact, z: "method", stroke: d => colors[d.method], strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5,3"}),
    Plot.dot(rows.filter(d => d.pick), {x: "gpu_hours", y: d => 100 * d.exact, r: 8, stroke: d => colors[d.method], strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.dot(rows, {x: "gpu_hours", y: d => 100 * d.exact, fill: d => colors[d.method], r: 3.5,
      tip: true, title: d => `${names[d.method]}, step ${d.step}${d.pick ? " (selected)" : ""}\n${d.gpu_hours.toFixed(2)} GPU-hours\n${(100 * d.exact).toFixed(1)}% on validation`}),
    Plot.text(ends, {x: "gpu_hours", y: d => 100 * d.exact, text: d => names[d.method], dx: 8, textAnchor: "start"}),
  ],
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
picks = fig.data.picks.filter(d => shown.includes(d.method)).sort((a, b) => b.exact - a.exact)
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 860), height: 66 + 32 * picks.length, marginLeft: 90, marginRight: 70, marginBottom: 46, style: {fontSize: "13px"},
  x: {label: "exact match on test-clean (%) →", domain: [50, 100], grid: true, labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 38},
  y: {label: null, domain: picks.map(d => names[d.method])},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX(fig.data.baselines.filter(b => b.split === "test-clean"), {x: d => 100 * d.exact, stroke: "#898781", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text(fig.data.baselines.filter(b => b.split === "test-clean"), {x: d => 100 * d.exact, frameAnchor: "top", text: d => d.model === "raw 2B" ? "2B" : "0.8B", dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#898781"}),
    Plot.ruleY(picks, {y: d => names[d.method], x1: d => 100 * d.ci[0], x2: d => 100 * d.ci[1], stroke: d => colors[d.method], strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(picks, {y: d => names[d.method], x: d => 100 * d.exact, r: 5, stroke: d => colors[d.method], fill: d => d.labels ? "white" : colors[d.method], strokeWidth: 1.5,
      tip: true, title: d => `${names[d.method]}${d.labels ? " (uses labels)" : ""}, step ${d.step}\n${(100 * d.exact).toFixed(1)}% [${(100 * d.ci[0]).toFixed(1)}, ${(100 * d.ci[1]).toFixed(1)}]\n${d.gpu_hours.toFixed(2)} GPU-hours`}),
    Plot.text(picks, {y: d => names[d.method], x: 100, text: d => `${d.gpu_hours.toFixed(1)} h`, dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#898781"}),
  ],
})
```

::: {.caption}
Top: exact match on validation at every checkpoint, against GPU-hours (the teacher's passes
included); rings mark each run's selected checkpoint, dashed lines used labels. Bottom: each selected
checkpoint on test-clean, with its 95% interval; hollow dots used labels. Hover for details. Training
curves: [W&B](https://forge.coreweave.com/wandb/joaomigueloliveira30/qwen-function-calling-distillation).
:::
